# temps_ingress_hostname (Resource)

How one hostname reaches visitors: chosen automatically, through a given tunnel (`temps_ingress_connector`), or not published. Destroying the resource sets it back to `automatic`.

Import with `<hostname>`.

Required API key permissions: `settings:read`, `settings:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_ingress_hostname" "internal" {
  hostname = "internal.example.com"
  mode     = "off"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String) The hostname.
- `mode` (String) How it is published. One of `automatic`, `tunnel`, `off`.

### Optional

- `connector_id` (Number) Tunnel to publish it through (`tunnel`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<hostname>`.
- `state` (String) Publication state.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <hostname>
terraform import temps_ingress_hostname.internal internal.example.com
```
